description: This file is a makefile for building Linux kernel and initramfs components within the OpenWrt project, containing build rules, configuration settings, and conditional logic for kernel preparation and compilation.

methods.name: Kernel/Prepare/Default
methods.description: Prepares the kernel source, either by extracting from a tarball or linking to an external kernel tree based on configuration.

methods.name: Kernel/SetInitramfs/PreConfigure
methods.description: Prepares the kernel configuration for initramfs, modifying the .config file accordingly.

methods.name: Kernel/SetInitramfs
methods.description: Sets up the kernel configuration for initramfs, updating .config with UID, GID, compression options, and other settings.

methods.name: Kernel/SetNoInitramfs
methods.description: Removes initramfs configuration from the kernel config.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure/Default
methods.description: Configures the kernel build, copying kernel settings, generating configuration files, and preparing headers.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure/Initramfs
methods.description: Configures the kernel for initramfs build.

methods.name: Kernel/CopyImage
methods.description: Copies the built kernel image and related files to the target directory.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage/Default
methods.description: Builds the kernel image and modules.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage/Initramfs
methods.description: Builds the kernel image with initramfs if configured.
